name: Motorcycle
description: Every motor vehicle with a seat or saddle for the rider designed to travel on no more than three wheels. An electric two-wheeler with a seat that can go faster than 40 mph is past the limited use motorcycle category and is one.

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle for the rider, and no more than three wheels on the ground
A seated electric two- or three-wheeler with a maximum performance speed over 40 mph is a motorcycle rather than a limited use motorcycle
Riders need a class M motorcycle license, or class MJ at 16 or 17, starting from a motorcycle learner permit
Riders under 18 must wait six months on the learner permit before the road test; a Basic Rider Course can waive the road test
Riders and passengers must wear a protective helmet
Riders must wear goggles or a face shield
Titled, registered and insured with the DMV
A dirt bike built for off-road trails or competition can't be registered for road use; it's registered as an ATV
